-- Displays the server's shop offers during the wave break. Buttons only send slot numbers;
-- the server decides whether a purchase or reroll is allowed.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Remotes = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local RARITY_COLORS = {
	Common = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 200),
	Rare = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 60),
}

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "Shop"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Enabled = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -20)
panel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(560, 230)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 24, 32)
panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
panel.Parent = gui

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Upgrade Shop"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 20
title.Parent = panel

local cards = Instance.new("Frame")
cards.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 35)
cards.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 140)
cards.BackgroundTransparency = 1
cards.Parent = panel

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
layout.Parent = cards

local reroll = Instance.new("TextButton")
reroll.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
reroll.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8)
reroll.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(180, 32)
reroll.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 70, 90)
reroll.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
reroll.TextSize = 16
reroll.Parent = panel
reroll.Activated:Connect(function()
	Remotes.RerollOffers:FireServer()
end)

local function coins(): number
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local value = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	return value and value.Value or 0
end

local function addLabel(parent: Instance, text: string, y: number, height: number, size: number, color: Color3)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, y)
	l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, height)
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Text = text
	l.TextColor3 = color
	l.TextWrapped = true
	l.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	l.TextSize = size
	l.Parent = parent
end

local lastState

local function render(state)
	lastState = state
	gui.Enabled = state.Open
	for _, child in cards:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local count = math.max(#state.Offers, 1)
	local balance = coins()

	for slot, offer in state.Offers do
		local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
		-- Scale-based width: AbsoluteSize can still be 0 on the first render after enabling.
		card.Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, -10 * (count - 1) / count, 1, 0)
		card.Text = ""
		card.AutoButtonColor = not offer.Bought
		card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 42, 56)
		card.BorderSizePixel = 0
		card.Parent = cards

		addLabel(card, offer.Name, 6, 22, 16, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		addLabel(card, offer.Rarity, 28, 16, 13, RARITY_COLORS[offer.Rarity])
		addLabel(card, offer.Description, 48, 50, 14, Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215))

		local costColor = if offer.Bought
			then Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
			elseif balance >= offer.Cost then Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80)
			else Color3.fromRGB(230, 90, 90)
		addLabel(card, offer.Bought and "Purchased" or offer.Cost .. " coins", 108, 24, 16, costColor)

		card.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not offer.Bought then
				Remotes.BuyOffer:FireServer(slot)
			end
		end)
	end

	reroll.Text = "Reroll (" .. state.RerollCost .. " coins)"
	reroll.TextColor3 = if balance >= state.RerollCost then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Color3.fromRGB(230, 90, 90)
end

Remotes.ShopUpdate.OnClientEvent:Connect(render)

-- Re-render when coins change so affordability colours stay current.
player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Coins"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
	if lastState and lastState.Open then
		render(lastState)
	end
end)

Remotes.ShopSync:FireServer()

1	-- Spawns zombies at the arena edge, chases the nearest player, and applies blade damage.
2	-- Blades are moved client-side, so hits are computed here from the same shared orbit math.
3	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
4	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
5	
6	local Shared = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared
7	local BladeConfig = require(Shared.Config).Blades
8	local Config = require(Shared.Config).Zombies
9	local BladeMath = require(Shared.BladeMath)
10	local Coins = require(script.Parent.Coins)
11	local Shop = require(script.Parent.Shop)
12	
13	local bladesRoot = workspace:WaitForChild("Blades")
14	
15	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
16	folder.Name = "Zombies"
17	folder.Parent = workspace
18	
19	local alive = 0
20	local lastAttacker: { [Model]: Player } = {}
21	local lastHit: { [Model]: { [string]: number } } = {}
22	
23	local function makePart(name: string, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3): Part
24		local part = Instance.new("Part")
25		part.Name = name
26		part.Size = size
27		part.Position = pos
28		part.Color = Config.Color
29		part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
30		return part
31	end
32	
33	local function award(zombie: Model)
34		local player = lastAttacker[zombie]
35		local stats = player and player.Parent and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
36		if not stats then
37			return
38		end
39		Coins.add(player, math.round(Config.CoinsPerKill * (1 + (player:GetAttribute("CoinBonus") or 0))))
40		stats.Kills.Value += 1
41	
42		local heal = player:GetAttribute("LifeSteal")
43		local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
44		if heal and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
45			humanoid.Health += heal -- Humanoid clamps to MaxHealth
46		end
47	end
48	
49	local function spawnZombie(health: number)
50		local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
51		-- Square arena: project the random direction onto the square edge.
52		local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
53		local scale = Config.SpawnRadius / math.max(math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Z))
54		local pos = dir * scale + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
55	
56		local zombie = Instance.new("Model")
57		zombie.Name = "Zombie"
58	
59		local root = makePart("HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), pos)
60		local head = makePart("Head", Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.75, 0))
61		local legs = makePart("Legs", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), pos - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
62		for _, part in { head, legs } do
63			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
64			weld.Part0 = root
65			weld.Part1 = part
66			weld.Parent = part
67		end
68		root.Parent = zombie
69		head.Parent = zombie
70		legs.Parent = zombie
71	
72		local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
73		humanoid.MaxHealth = health
74		humanoid.Health = health
75		humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeed
76		humanoid.HipHeight = 2
77		-- This rig has no Torso/Neck, so the default RequiresNeck would break the humanoid.
78		humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
79		humanoid.Parent = zombie
80	
81		zombie.PrimaryPart = root
82		zombie.Parent = folder
83		root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
84	
85		alive += 1
86		lastHit[zombie] = {}
87		local finished = false
88		local function finish()
89			if finished then
90				return
91			end
92			finished = true
93			alive -= 1
94			lastAttacker[zombie] = nil
95			lastHit[zombie] = nil
96		end
97		-- Zombies removed without dying (e.g. falling out of the world) must still stop counting
98		-- as alive, otherwise the wave never ends and the shop never opens.
99		zombie.Destroying:Connect(finish)
100		humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
101			if finished then
102				return
103			end
104			award(zombie)
105			finish()
106			task.delay(1, function()
107				zombie:Destroy()
108			end)
109		end)
110	end
111	
112	local function nearestPlayerRoot(from: Vector3): BasePart?
113		local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
114		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
115			local character = player.Character
116			local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
117			local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
118			if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
119				local dist = (hrp.Position - from).Magnitude
120				if dist < bestDist then
121					best, bestDist = hrp, dist
122				end
123			end
124		end
125		return best
126	end
127	
128	-- Waves: spawn the wave's quota (capped by MaxAlive at once), wait for it to be cleared, then break.
129	task.spawn(function()
130		local wave = 1
131		while true do
132			local quota = Config.FirstWaveCount + Config.CountPerWave * (wave - 1)
133			local health = Config.Health * (1 + Config.HealthGrowth * (wave - 1))
134			local spawned = 0
135			while spawned < quota or alive > 0 do
136				if spawned < quota and alive < Config.MaxAlive and #Players:GetPlayers() > 0 then
137					spawnZombie(health)
138					spawned += 1
139				end
140				task.wait(Config.SpawnInterval)
141			end
142			Shop.open()
143			task.wait(Config.WaveBreak)
144			Shop.close()
145			wave += 1
146		end
147	end)
148	
149	-- Contact damage
150	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
151		for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
152			local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
153			local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
154			if not (humanoid and root) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
155				continue
156			end
157			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
158				local character = player.Character
159				local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
160				local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
161				if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 and (hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= Config.ContactRadius then
162					-- Not TakeDamage: it is blocked by ForceFields (e.g. spawn protection).
163					hum.Health -= Config.ContactDamage * dt
164				end
165			end
166		end
167	end)
168	
169	-- Chasing
170	task.spawn(function()
171		while true do
172			task.wait(0.2)
173			for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
174				local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
175				local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
176				if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root then
177					local target = nearestPlayerRoot(root.Position)
178					if target then
179						humanoid:MoveTo(target.Position)
180					end
181				end
182			end
183		end
184	end)
185	
186	-- Blade hits
187	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
188		local t = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
189		local now = os.clock()
190	
191		for _, bladeFolder in bladesRoot:GetChildren() do
192			local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(bladeFolder.Name) or 0)
193			local hrp = player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
194			if not player or not hrp then
195				continue
196			end
197	
198			local count = #bladeFolder:GetChildren()
199			local reach = player:GetAttribute("Reach") or 0
200			local damage = BladeConfig.Damage * (1 + (player:GetAttribute("DamageBonus") or 0))
201			for index = 1, count do
202				local bladePos = hrp.Position + BladeMath.getOffset(index, count, t, reach)
203				local key = bladeFolder.Name .. ":" .. index
204	
205				for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
206					local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
207					local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
208					local hits = lastHit[zombie]
209					if not (humanoid and root and hits) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
210						continue
211					end
212					if (root.Position - bladePos).Magnitude > BladeConfig.HitRadius then
213						continue
214					end

-- Spawns zombies at the arena edge, chases the nearest player, and applies blade damage.
-- Blades are moved client-side, so hits are computed here from the same shared orbit math.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local BladeConfig = require(Shared.Config).Blades
local Config = require(Shared.Config).Zombies
local BladeMath = require(Shared.BladeMath)
local Coins = require(script.Parent.Coins)
local Shop = require(script.Parent.Shop)

local bladesRoot = workspace:WaitForChild("Blades")

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Zombies"
folder.Parent = workspace

local alive = 0
local lastAttacker: { [Model]: Player } = {}
local lastHit: { [Model]: { [string]: number } } = {}

local function makePart(name: string, size: Vector3, pos: Vector3): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Position = pos
	part.Color = Config.Color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	return part
end

local function award(zombie: Model)
	local player = lastAttacker[zombie]
	local stats = player and player.Parent and player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then
		return
	end
	Coins.add(player, math.round(Config.CoinsPerKill * (1 + (player:GetAttribute("CoinBonus") or 0))))
	stats.Kills.Value += 1

	local heal = player:GetAttribute("LifeSteal")
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if heal and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid.Health += heal -- Humanoid clamps to MaxHealth
	end
end

local function spawnZombie(health: number)
	local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
	-- Square arena: project the random direction onto the square edge.
	local dir = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle))
	local scale = Config.SpawnRadius / math.max(math.abs(dir.X), math.abs(dir.Z))
	local pos = dir * scale + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)

	local zombie = Instance.new("Model")
	zombie.Name = "Zombie"

	local root = makePart("HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), pos)
	local head = makePart("Head", Vector3.new(1.5, 1.5, 1.5), pos + Vector3.new(0, 1.75, 0))
	local legs = makePart("Legs", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), pos - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
	for _, part in { head, legs } do
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = root
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.Parent = part
	end
	root.Parent = zombie
	head.Parent = zombie
	legs.Parent = zombie

	local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	humanoid.MaxHealth = health
	humanoid.Health = health
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.WalkSpeed
	humanoid.HipHeight = 2
	-- This rig has no Torso/Neck, so the default RequiresNeck would break the humanoid.
	humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
	humanoid.Parent = zombie

	zombie.PrimaryPart = root
	zombie.Parent = folder
	root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)

	alive += 1
	lastHit[zombie] = {}
	local finished = false
	local function finish()
		if finished then
			return
		end
		finished = true
		alive -= 1
		lastAttacker[zombie] = nil
		lastHit[zombie] = nil
	end
	-- Zombies removed without dying (e.g. falling out of the world) must still stop counting
	-- as alive, otherwise the wave never ends and the shop never opens.
	zombie.Destroying:Connect(finish)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		if finished then
			return
		end
		award(zombie)
		finish()
		task.delay(1, function()
			zombie:Destroy()
		end)
	end)
end

local function nearestPlayerRoot(from: Vector3): BasePart?
	local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
			local dist = (hrp.Position - from).Magnitude
			if dist < bestDist then
				best, bestDist = hrp, dist
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

-- Waves: spawn the wave's quota (capped by MaxAlive at once), wait for it to be cleared, then break.
task.spawn(function()
	local wave = 1
	while true do
		local quota = Config.FirstWaveCount + Config.CountPerWave * (wave - 1)
		local health = Config.Health * (1 + Config.HealthGrowth * (wave - 1))
		local spawned = 0
		while spawned < quota or alive > 0 do
			if spawned < quota and alive < Config.MaxAlive and #Players:GetPlayers() > 0 then
				spawnZombie(health)
				spawned += 1
			end
			task.wait(Config.SpawnInterval)
		end
		Shop.open()
		task.wait(Config.WaveBreak)
		Shop.close()
		wave += 1
	end
end)

-- Contact damage
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
		local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
		if not (humanoid and root) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 and (hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= Config.ContactRadius then
				-- Not TakeDamage: it is blocked by ForceFields (e.g. spawn protection).
				hum.Health -= Config.ContactDamage * dt
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Chasing
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.2)
		for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
			local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
			if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root then
				local target = nearestPlayerRoot(root.Position)
				if target then
					humanoid:MoveTo(target.Position)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Blade hits
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local t = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	local now = os.clock()

	for _, bladeFolder in bladesRoot:GetChildren() do
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(tonumber(bladeFolder.Name) or 0)
		local hrp = player and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not player or not hrp then
			continue
		end

		local count = #bladeFolder:GetChildren()
		local reach = player:GetAttribute("Reach") or 0
		local damage = BladeConfig.Damage * (1 + (player:GetAttribute("DamageBonus") or 0))
		for index = 1, count do
			local bladePos = hrp.Position + BladeMath.getOffset(index, count, t, reach)
			local key = bladeFolder.Name .. ":" .. index

			for _, zombie in folder:GetChildren() do
				local humanoid = zombie:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local root = zombie.PrimaryPart
				local hits = lastHit[zombie]
				if not (humanoid and root and hits) or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
					continue
				end
				if (root.Position - bladePos).Magnitude > BladeConfig.HitRadius then
					continue
				end
				if now - (hits[key] or -math.huge) < BladeConfig.HitCooldown then
					continue
				end
				hits[key] = now
				lastAttacker[zombie] = player
				humanoid:TakeDamage(damage)
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- clients only display offers and send slot numbers.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Shared = game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)
local Coins = require(script.Parent.Coins)

local ShopConfig = Config.Shop

local isOpen = false
local offers: { [Player]: { { Id: string, Bought: boolean } } } = {}

local function bump(player: Player, name: string, amount: number, default: number)
	player:SetAttribute(name, (player:GetAttribute(name) or default) + amount)
end

local function applyMaxHealth(player: Player, heal: number?)
	local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	humanoid.MaxHealth = Config.Player.MaxHealth + (player:GetAttribute("BonusMaxHealth") or 0)
	if heal then
		humanoid.Health += heal
	end
end

-- Attributes replicate to clients, so visual ones (Reach, SpinMult) need no remote.
local effects = {
	Blade = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "BladeCount", amount, Config.Blades.StartCount)
	end,
	Damage = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "DamageBonus", amount, 0)
	end,
	Spin = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "SpinMult", amount, 1)
	end,
	Reach = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "Reach", amount, 0)
	end,
	Vitality = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "BonusMaxHealth", amount, 0)
		applyMaxHealth(player, amount)
	end,
	Vampiric = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "LifeSteal", amount, 0)
	end,
	Greed = function(player, amount)
		bump(player, "CoinBonus", amount, 0)
	end,
}

local byId = {}
for _, upgrade in ShopConfig.Upgrades do
	byId[upgrade.Id] = upgrade
end

-- Weighted pick without replacement so a shop never shows the same upgrade twice.
local function roll(): { { Id: string, Bought: boolean } }
	local pool = table.clone(ShopConfig.Upgrades)
	local result = {}
	for _ = 1, math.min(ShopConfig.OfferCount, #pool) do
		local total = 0
		for _, upgrade in pool do
			total += ShopConfig.RarityWeight[upgrade.Rarity]
		end
		local pick = math.random() * total
		for i, upgrade in pool do
			pick -= ShopConfig.RarityWeight[upgrade.Rarity]
			if pick <= 0 or i == #pool then
				table.insert(result, { Id = upgrade.Id, Bought = false })
				table.remove(pool, i)
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end

	local list = {}
	for _, offer in offers[player] or {} do
		local upgrade = byId[offer.Id]
		table.insert(list, {
			Name = upgrade.Name,
			Rarity = upgrade.Rarity,
			Cost = upgrade.Cost,
			Description = upgrade.Description,
			Bought = offer.Bought,
		})
	end
	Remotes.ShopUpdate:FireClient(player, { Open = isOpen, RerollCost = ShopConfig.RerollCost, Offers = list })
end

local Shop = {}

function Shop.open()
	isOpen = true
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		offers[player] = roll()
		send(player)
	end
end

function Shop.close()
	isOpen = false
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		send(player)
	end
end

Remotes.ShopSync.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if isOpen and not offers[player] then
		offers[player] = roll()
	end
	send(player)
end)

Remotes.BuyOffer.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, slot)
	local list = offers[player]
	if not isOpen or not list or type(slot) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	local offer = list[slot]
	if not offer or offer.Bought then
		return
	end
	local upgrade = byId[offer.Id]
	if not Coins.trySpend(player, upgrade.Cost) then
		return
	end
	offer.Bought = true
	effects[upgrade.Id](player, upgrade.Amount)
	send(player)
end)

Remotes.RerollOffers.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	if not isOpen or not Coins.trySpend(player, ShopConfig.RerollCost) then
		return
	end
	offers[player] = roll()
	send(player)
end)

local function watchCharacter(player: Player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.defer(applyMaxHealth, player)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)
for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	watchCharacter(player)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	offers[player] = nil
end)

return Shop

	divider.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7

status.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 78)

	seconds = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", seconds // 60, seconds % 60)

	refreshHealth()

refreshWave()
refreshCoins()

reroll.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
reroll.TextSize = 16
reroll.Parent = panel
reroll.Activated:Connect(function()
	Remotes.RerollOffers:FireServer()
end)

local function coins(): number
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local value = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	return value and value.Value or 0
end

local function addLabel(parent: Instance, text: string, y: number, height: number, size: number, color: Color3)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, y)
	l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, height)
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Text = text
	l.TextColor3 = color
	l.TextWrapped = true
	l.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
	l.TextSize = size
	l.Parent = parent
end

local lastState

local function render(state)
	lastState = state
	gui.Enabled = state.Open
	for _, child in cards:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local count = math.max(#state.Offers, 1)
	local balance = coins()

	for slot, offer in state.Offers do
		local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
		-- Scale-based width: AbsoluteSize can still be 0 on the first render after enabling.
		card.Size = UDim2.new(1 / count, -10 * (count - 1) / count, 1, 0)
		card.Text = ""
		card.AutoButtonColor = not offer.Bought
		card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 42, 56)
		card.BorderSizePixel = 0
		card.Parent = cards

		addLabel(card, offer.Name, 6, 22, 16, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
		addLabel(card, offer.Rarity, 28, 16, 13, RARITY_COLORS[offer.Rarity])
		addLabel(card, offer.Description, 48, 50, 14, Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215))

			then Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130)
			elseif balance >= offer.Cost then Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 80)
			else Color3.fromRGB(230, 90, 90)
		addLabel(card, offer.Bought and "Purchased" or offer.Cost .. " coins", 108, 24, 16, costColor)

		card.Activated:Connect(function()
			if not offer.Bought then
				Remotes.BuyOffer:FireServer(slot)
			end
		end)
	end

	reroll.Text = "Reroll (" .. state.RerollCost .. " coins)"
	reroll.TextColor3 = if balance >= state.RerollCost then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Color3.fromRGB(230, 90, 90)
end

Remotes.ShopUpdate.OnClientEvent:Connect(render)

player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Coins"):GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
	if lastState and lastState.Open then
		render(lastState)
	end
end)

I redesigned the HUD and shop UI, but none of it has been run. There's no Rojo or Studio check here, so the Luau is untested.

**Look**
- Panels are dark navy with rounded corners and a thin cyan outline. The colors live in a new `Config.Ui` table in `src/shared/Config.lua`.
- Coins are gold everywhere. Costs turn red when you can't afford them.
- Rarity colors are Common gray, Rare blue and Epic purple. Epic has a color, but no Epic upgrades exist yet.
- Shop cards have a rarity-colored border and top strip, the rarity label, and a "PURCHASED" state. The shop header shows your coin balance.

**HUD** (`src/client/Hud.client.lua`)
- **Top center:** WAVE, a countdown, and ZOMBIES LEFT. The timer counts down the break before the next wave, turns red in the last 5 seconds, and reads "FIGHT!" during a wave.
- **Bottom left:** a coins readout and a health bar with a "current / max" number. The bar turns red at 25% or less.

**Code**
- `src/client/UiKit.lua` is new. It holds the shared panel, label, corner and stroke builders.
- `src/client/ShopUi.client.lua` is rewritten to use the same theme.
- `src/server/Zombies.server.lua` now publishes `Wave`, `ZombiesLeft` and `BreakEndsAt` as workspace attributes. They replicate to clients, so I didn't add a remote.

**Zombie contact damage:** you've said zombies shouldn't hurt you on touch, but `Zombies.server.lua` still has a contact-damage loop (`ContactDamage = 10`). I left it alone because it's separate from this change. If you want it off, say so and I'll remove it.
